title: Local stability of cosine configurations for Gaussian minima
description: Unrefereed AI-assisted mathematical candidate. For every fixed n at least 3 and moment exponent p greater than 1, the paper derives the second variation of the Gaussian minimum moment at equally spaced planar cosine configurations, including rank-increasing directions, and establishes strict local minimality modulo symmetries. The global Gaussian-minimum conjecture remains unresolved. The local neighbourhood is existential, not a certified numerical radius or uniform estimate over the parameters. Exact finite algebra and floating-point diagnostics do not certify the analytic theorem. Original prose/data are CC0-1.0 and original code is MIT.
